messages:
maria: Heads-up — opened a small PR to update the metering header name and add SDK examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1291
jon: Thanks, looking. What's the exact header change? we should be explicit for migration notes.
sam: fyi need both token and embedding metering snippets. I'll add python + node.
maria: header: X-RI-Usage (replaces X-Old-Metering). Add migration note: servers will accept both for 30d.
lucy: also we renamed the dashboard panel id (usage-breakdown -> usage-by-tier). links in docs need anchors updated. I can patch the panels.yml anchor.
maria: perfect. can someone add the quick dashboard anchor line? just want the docs links to land correctly from the pricing page.
jon: I'll update the pricing page to link to the new panel id and add a short blurb about burst credits vs committed tiers. Keep it 2–3 sentences.
sam: code samples — proposed minimal py snippet:
```python
# python snippet: set metering header
import requests
headers = {
  "Authorization": "Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY",
  "X-RI-Usage": "project=acme;units=prompt_tokens:42"
}
resp = requests.post("https://api.redwood.dev/generate", headers=headers, json={"prompt":"hi"})
```
jon: can you add the same in node and a short note about how embedding units are counted?
sam: yes. node example:```js
fetch(url, {method:'POST', headers:{'X-RI-Usage':'project=acme;units=embedding_vectors:1'}})
```
lucy: QA checklist: update panels.yml anchor, update pricing link, run local docs build (`make docs-serve`) and verify anchors, then tag @maria for final review.
maria: tagging here so it's easy to follow — @jon @sam @lucy please ping when ready. small wording request: emphasize that metering is per-unit and we prorate partial units.
jon: ack. will add brief sentence and an example arithmetic line.
sam: added both snippets + short note on embedding vs token units. pushed to branch. link in PR description points to a deployed staging build: https://deploy-preview-1291--docs.redwood.dev
lucy: made the panels.yml anchor change and updated the dashboard link in pricing. tested locally, anchors work.
maria: looks great. can we also drop a one-line changelog entry under /release-notes/docs (short summary)?
jon: done. entry: "Normalize metering header to X-RI-Usage; update SDK snippets and pricing dashboard links."
docs-bot: deploy started for branch docs/pr/1291 — staging build: https://deploy-preview-1291--docs.redwood.dev (ETA ~3m) :rocket:
maria: will review staging and merge after green. thanks team :thumbsup:
jon: thumbs up. we'll monitor for any missing links post-merge.
